task.description: WF-03 Step 7 (Doc Update) for ISS-0106 / GitHub #364. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry for the fix: build.zig now serializes the test_iss503_rls_removal.zig test binary out of the concurrent test-integration group via a new barrier step, eliminating a proven Postgres deadlock mechanism (40P01) where ISS-503 raced other DDL/migration-touching test binaries for AccessExclusiveLock. Mark docs/issues/ISS-0106.json status RESOLVED with resolved_at, resolution, and prevention fields filled in. Update docs/issues/issue_index.json to reflect RESOLVED status and resolved_at for ISS-0106. In the changelog entry and/or ISS-0106.json resolution text, explicitly note that a separate, independently-tracked issue (ISS-0107 / GitHub #366) remains open for the ~19+ other test-integration binaries deadlocking among themselves -- this is NOT part of what ISS-0106 fixed, and TC-DB-01-01/02 (db_integration_test.zig) will continue to intermittently fail under full concurrent zig build test-integration until ISS-0107 is separately resolved. Also add an entry to docs/anti-patterns.md if the ISS-0106 root cause reveals a reusable pattern worth cataloguing (a raw pg.Conn test binary bypassing the shared advisory-lock/ TestHarness machinery and holding AccessExclusiveLock for an extended uncommitted-transaction window while running concurrently with other DDL-touching binaries) -- follow the existing table format and link to GitHub #364.
acceptance_criteria: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry for this fix under the current version/unreleased section
docs/issues/ISS-0106.json status is RESOLVED with resolved_at, resolution, prevention filled
docs/issues/issue_index.json reflects RESOLVED status for ISS-0106
docs/anti-patterns.md has a new entry for the raw-connection-bypasses-shared-lock pattern, cross-referencing #364
ISS-0107/GitHub #366 clearly noted as a separate follow-up, not resolved by this change

result.summary: Updated CHANGELOG.md with a new top entry for ISS-0106/#364 (build.zig test-integration-others-internal barrier serializing test_iss503_rls_removal.zig out of the concurrent test-integration group), citing TEST-RUNNER's zero-ISS-503-occurrences verification and explicitly noting ISS-0107/#366 remains open as a separate, unresolved follow-up. Marked docs/issues/ISS-0106.json status RESOLVED with resolved_at, a resolution paragraph summarizing the build.zig barrier-step fix and citing the Step 5 verification evidence, and a prevention array with 4 guardrail lessons (cross-referencing the new anti-patterns.md entry). Inserted a new ISS-0106 entry into docs/issues/issue_index.json (it was not previously present in the index) with status RESOLVED and matching resolved_at. Added a new row to docs/anti-patterns.md's Database / Migrations table documenting the raw-pg.Conn-bypasses-shared-lock pattern, cross-referenced to GitHub #364/ISS-0106, following the existing table's exact Markdown format and citation style. docs/status/requirement_status.yaml was confirmed N/A and left untouched -- this fix touches no functional requirement ID (confirmed by RELEASE-VALIDATOR's own scope_note and by git diff main --stat).
